done.description: Whether the gateway now writes for the caller. False means ask again.

main.description: Fails with 403 when the authorization was refused or did not log in as the caller, and with 404 for a delegation the caller did not start or that has ended.

description: Waits, for a while, for a delegation the caller started with dev.knotless.putDelegation to be approved. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
